baseline.hypothesis: Reference: the initial TF-IDF agent with 2400 context characters and three searches.

compact_context.hypothesis: Less context may reduce irrelevant citations and prompt tokens. It may also remove required evidence.
compact_context.motivation: The dense D01 smoke cited an unrelated page 7 diagram.

two_searches.hypothesis: Two searches may preserve answer quality while reducing repeated searches and API cost.
two_searches.motivation: D16 used three similar queries and returned the same stash passages before abstaining.

selection_order: highest strict pass count over all 17 dev cases; errors count as failures
highest grounded answer sum; answerable errors count as zero
lowest reported API cost; unknown costs rank last
strict_pass: Answerable: grade 2, context grade 2, answered, non-empty citations and all citations supported. Unanswerable: reviewed correct abstention. Errors fail.
test_policy: Freeze baseline, selected configuration, source code and inputs after complete dev review; then run both variants on all seven test cases. Do not tune on test.
